headwords: ông nói gà, bà nói vịt
ông ăn chả, bà ăn nem

flags.why: The example lists and explains the virtues instead of showing the expression in use.
flags.fix: Ông luôn lấy ôn, lương, cung, kiệm, nhượng làm chuẩn mực ứng xử. = He always takes these five virtues as his standard of conduct.

flags.why: The example defines the kinship term instead of using it in an ordinary situation.
flags.fix: Hôm qua ông trẻ đến thăm gia đình em. = Yesterday my great-uncle came to visit my family.

flags.why: The Southern tag misleadingly restricts a term also used elsewhere in Vietnam, including [Northern childhood accounts](https://thuviensohoa.vn/img/pdf/14715-le-van-yeu-va-song-thuviensach.vn.pdf).
The Vietnamese sentence does not specify that the boy is the youngest child.
flags.fix: Your little boy has just turned five.
